KEN.note: Refugee ID cards only; no authentication service is stated.
No civil register to ID link is stated.
Only a refugee right to civil registration under the Refugee Act is stated; no digital register.
Refugee cards and refugee counts only; no national ID enrolment share.
No number at birth is stated.
No operation or ownership of an ID system is stated.
No register keyed on a national ID number is stated.
Refugee ID cards are a sectoral ID, not the national ID system.

facts.fact: The Commissioner of Refugee Affairs said 12,750 refugee identity cards lay uncollected at centres including Dadaab (6,099) and Kakuma and Kalobeyei (2,302), among over 650,000 registered refugees and asylum-seekers, reports The Eastleigh Voice.

KEN.note: No local civil registration office practice is stated.
